Oscar L.: Heads-up: Orion Data sent INV-OR-0620 for $16,320 but the PDF doesn't show a PO. Vendor says it's due in 9 days. Can procurement confirm PO or ask for reissue?
Invoices Bot: New invoice uploaded: INV-OR-0620  amount $16,320  status: unmatched. Link: https://accounting.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-OR-0620
Evan (Procurement): Searching... we have PO-81220 for 'Data ingress credits' for $15k. Looks like this invoice includes a one-time onboarding fee of $1,320 that wasn't on the PO.
Orion Billing: Sorry about that  our billing export omitted PO when an ad-hoc fee was applied. We can reissue INV-OR-0620-R1 with PO-81220 on the header and a separate line for the onboarding fee. Want us to include both PO-81220 and a supplemental PO if you provide one?
Oscar L.: Reissue with PO-81220 on header and line items is fine. Procurement can create a supplemental PO if needed. Also please include remittance and SWIFT we have on file, vendor sent old bank details previously.
Hannah (AP): If PO is on header we can auto-match $15k to PO-81220. The $1,320 onboarding fee will require cost owner approval and finance lead sign-off if >$1k. Anika will need to review.
Anika (Finance Manager): Confirm routing: invoice > $1k onboarding fee -> route to me. Please ensure GL mapping to 5302-DATA and cost center infra-data.
Evan (Procurement): I'll create PO-81220-S1 for the onboarding fee so AP can match both lines automatically. Will update vendor to include both PO-81220 and PO-81220-S1 on the reissued PDF.
Orion Billing: Reissue scheduled today. We'll upload INV-OR-0620-R1 with both PO numbers on header and corrected bank details.
Invoices Bot: Invoice INV-OR-0620-R1 uploaded  amount $16,320  status: pending match. Link: https://accounting.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-OR-0620-R1
Hannah (AP): Received. Matched $15k to PO-81220 and PO-81220-S1 for $1,320. Routing to Anika for finance review.
Anika (Finance Manager): Reviewed and approved charge to GL 5302-DATA, cost center infra-data. Approve routing for payment.
Hannah (AP): Scheduling payment on next AP cycle. Noted vendor updated bank details; please confirm with treasury if SWIFT changed.
Evan (Procurement): Confirmed with Orion that bank details were corrected in vendor portal.
Oscar L.: Thanks everyone. I'll log ticket: "Orion invoice omitted PO when ad-hoc fee present; reissued INV-OR-0620-R1; PO-81220 + PO-81220-S1; charge GL 5302-DATA; routed to Anika; payment scheduled." :white_check_mark:
Orion Billing: Thanks, and apologies for the inconvenience. We'll flag export to include PO field for ad-hoc charges going forward.
